defs.def: to join together two or more things; to be joined together （使）连接；联结

ex.s: Families who volunteer together have the unique experience of working toward a common goal. ___40___ Everyone brings something unique to the table and can connect with each other in a new way.
ex.t: 一起做志愿服务的家庭，拥有朝着共同目标努力的独特体验。___40____ 每个人都带来独特的东西，并能以新的方式彼此联结。

ex.s: By connecting through the Cloud, BMF is remotely monitored.
ex.t: 通过云端连接，BMF可以被远程监控。

ex.s: Seemingly unrelated interests are in a way connected.
ex.t: 看似无关的兴趣在某种意义上是相连的。

ex.s: As we organized teams, prepared resources and practiced answering questions, I felt more connected than I ever had to any sports team.
ex.t: 当我们组队、准备资源并练习回答问题时，我感觉比以往任何时候都更融入任何一支运动队。

ex.s: They were closely connected
ex.t: 它们紧密相连

ex.s: Despite the celebrations, though, in the US the jazz audience continues to shrink and grow older, and the music has failed to connect with younger generations.
ex.t: 然而，尽管有各种庆祝活动，在美国，爵士乐听众仍在萎缩并老龄化，这种音乐也未能与年轻一代产生共鸣。

ex.s: The project connects flooded roads and highways.
ex.t: 该项目连接了被淹没的道路和公路。

ex.s: The Victoria Falls Bridge connects the countries Zimbabwe and Zambia.
ex.t: 维多利亚瀑布大桥连接着津巴布韦和赞比亚两国。

defs.def: to join sth to the main supply of electricity, gas, water, etc. or to another piece of equipment 使 … 连接；接通

ex.s: This is to do with how we can connect with a piece of art and what meaning we can create in it.
ex.t: 这与我们如何与一件艺术品产生连接，以及能在其中创造出什么意义有关。

defs.def: to join a computer to the Internet or a computer network 使（计算机）连接（到互联网或计算机网络）

ex.s: Things are connected.
ex.t: 万物都是相互联系的。

ex.s: Public libraries connected by a cooperative network benefit readers by______. （    ）
ex.t: 通过合作网络相连的公共图书馆以______造福读者。（    ）

ex.s: Whatever our hobbies, the Internet can connect us with others who also enjoy doing them, even if they live on the other side of the world.
ex.t: 无论我们的爱好是什么，互联网都能让我们与那些也喜欢这些爱好的人建立联系，即使他们生活在世界的另一端。

ex.s: Because of this, I’m careful not to connect what my kids weigh with their worth as people.
ex.t: 所以，如果我们接受宇宙是不可知的，我们也接受我们将永远无法知道自己是否生活在计算机模拟中。

ex.s: So far, this model ____19____ (produce) well-known universities, but it is now challenged by the digitalisation of society, which allows everybody ____20____ is connected to the Internet to access learning resources.
ex.t: 迄今为止，这种模式____19____（造就了）知名大学，但它现在受到社会数字化的挑战，数字化让每个____20____（连接）互联网的人都能获取学习资源。

defs.def: to notice or make a link between people, things, events, etc. 注意到 … 有关联；把 … 联系起来

ex.s: By helping us stay connected with the contemporary world.
ex.t: 通过帮助我们与当代世界保持联系。

ex.s: When I let them see an aspect of my life outside of school, some students who were also interested in cars connected with me more and became more engaged in my courses.
ex.t: 当我让他们看到我校外生活的一面时，一些同样对汽车感兴趣的学生与我更有共鸣，也更投入我的课程。

ex.s: It will really help connect our residents through a shared interest and creative activities.”
ex.t: 这真的会通过共同兴趣和创造性活动，帮助我们的住户建立联系。

ex.s: Some of your interests may not appear to be connected but, once you explore their depths, you discover that they are.
ex.t: 你的一些兴趣可能看起来互不相干，但一旦你探究它们的深度，就会发现它们是相关的。

ex.s: In trying to connect to her sister.
ex.t: 在试图与姐姐取得联系的过程中，

ex.s: HUNCH is designed to connect high school classrooms with NASA engineers.
ex.t: HUNCH旨在将高中课堂与NASA工程师联系起来。

ex.s: 8. ________our hobbies, the Internet can connect us with others who enjoy the same hobbies, even if they live on the other side of the world.
ex.t: 8. ________我们的爱好，互联网可以将我们与世界上其他地方享受相同爱好的人联系起来，即使他们住在地球的另一端。

ex.s: Other American studies showed no ___64___(connect) between uniforms and school performance.
ex.t: 美国的其他研究表明，校服与学业表现之间没有____64____（connect）联系。

ex.s: Why do we dream？Scientists aren't completely sure,and they have diverse____11____ (idea)．Dreams might be a side effect of memory making.When you sleep,your brain sorts through everything ____12____ happened during the day，trying to link new experiences to old memories.As it ____13____ (connect) things，your brain tums them into a story,and you get a dream．
ex.t: 我们为什么会做梦？科学家也不完全确定，他们有各种各样的___11___（想法）。梦可能是记忆形成的副作用。当你睡觉时，大脑会梳理白天发生的每一件事___12___，试图把新经历和旧记忆联系起来。当它___13___（连接）事物时，大脑把它们变成了一个故事，于是你便做了个梦。

ex.s: The team showed that this change in bite was connected with the development of agriculture in the Neolithic period.
ex.t: 团队表明，这种咬合变化与新石器时代农业的发展有关。

ex.s: “The key to successful small talk is learning how to connect with others, not just communicate with them.”
ex.t: "成功闲聊的关键是学会如何与他人建立联系，而不仅仅是与他们交流。"

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即便这种计时方式在细节上很新颖，早期的农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来。例如在前古典时期的希腊，人们会通过把日期向前或向后调整来“修正”官方历法，以反映季节的变化。与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要。同样，我们正在开发的河流时间和其他计时系统或许也能唤起人们的环保意识。

ex.s: The pace of life is slow and people _____49_____ connecting to each other.
ex.t: 那里的生活节奏缓慢，人们_____49_____彼此之间的联系。

ex.s: Although technology has changed the way we are connected, the meaning of friendship and our longing for friends haven't been changed.
ex.t: 虽然技术改变了我们联系的方式，但友谊的意义和我们对朋友的渴望并没有改变。

ex.s: Research also suggests that our desire to seek risks can be connected to how much we expect to 8_______________.
ex.t: 研究还表明，我们寻求风险的渴望可能与我们期望获得的多少有关 8_______________。

defs.def: to arrive just before another one leaves so that passengers can change from one to the other 衔接；联运

ex.s: Of course, connecting passengers don’t want to miss their flights.
ex.t: 当然，转机的乘客不想错过航班。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

defs.def: to join telephone lines so that people can speak to each other 为（某人）接通电话；连接

ex.s: I didn’t come from a family connected to the ____41____ world, which I perceived as a major ____42____.
ex.t: 我并非来自一个与____41____界有渊源的家庭，我认为这是一大____42____。

ex.s: When the final bell rang in June, I walked away with a yearbook full of messages about writing’s most powerful significance — the ability to connect people, to put us in another’s skin, to teach us what it means to be human.
ex.t: 当六月的下课铃响起，我带着一本写满留言的年鉴离开，那些话道出了写作最强大的意义——把人们连接起来、让我们设身处地、教会我们生而为人的含义。

ex.s: The lounge is like a pressure cooker because connecting passengers ____ .
ex.t: 休息室就像一个高压锅，因为中转乘客____。

ex.s: People who have personality traits that connect with competitiveness and low upset tolerance are much more likely to get angry.
ex.t: 具有竞争性和低挫折耐受力性格特征的人更有可能发怒。

ex.s: Thus, the keyboard can determine people's identities, and by extension, whether they should be given access to the computer it's connected to—regardless of whether someone gets the password right.
ex.t: 因此，键盘可以确定人们的身份，进而判断是否应允许他们使用与其连接的电脑——无论某人是否输入了正确的密码。

ex.s: First, he constructed a series of clear fiberglass tanks connected to each other.
ex.t: 首先，他建造了一系列相互连接的透明玻璃纤维水箱。

ex.s: If I ever get trapped outside my house again, my local telephone box will, sadly, no longer be able to connect me with my keys.
ex.t: 如果我再被锁在屋外，可悲的是，我家附近的电话亭将不再能帮我联系到钥匙了。

ex.s: The terraces are cleverly designed with hundreds of waterways that connect with each other.
ex.t: 露台设计巧妙，有数百条水道相互连接。

ex.s: ●Are you connected?
ex.t: 查尔斯·狄更斯写小说时会扮演各个角色，他在镜子里做鬼脸，为每个角色变换声音。

defs.def: to form a good relationship with sb so that you like and understand each other （与某人）建立良好关系，沟通

ex.s: Join us for TransForm, the interactive summer camp that helps you teens find your passion by participating in various activities and connecting with others.
ex.t: 加入我们的TransForm吧，这是一个互动夏令营，通过参与各种活动并与他人建立联系，帮助青少年找到自己的热情。

ex.s: Dr Prinstein has also found that the qualities that made the neighbors want you on a play date-sharing, kindness, openness — carry over to later years and make you better able to relate and connect with others.
ex.t: 普林斯坦博士还发现，那些让邻居愿意和你一起玩的品质——分享、善良、开放——会延续到以后 years，使你更好地与他人建立联系和沟通。

ex.s: This aspect of storytelling-presenting a different perspective of the world—is important when it comes to connecting with each other.
ex.t: 讲故事的这一面——呈现对世界的不同视角——在彼此建立联系时很重要。

defs.def: to hit sb/sth 打（某人）；击中（某物）
